title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec)
summary: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec) is an elastic compute infrastructure system designed for efficient allocation and scaling of computing resources in AI model training and inference workloads, developed by DeepSeek AI. The system appears to focus on optimizing resource utilization and cost efficiency for large-scale AI operations.
problem_solved: Provides dynamic, elastic compute resource management for AI training and inference workloads to optimize cost and resource utilization.
why_valuable: Enables organizations to efficiently scale AI infrastructure with cost-effective resource allocation, reducing operational overhead for large-scale model deployment.
